title: The Knight at Dawn
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie sneak into a misty castle and meet a brave knight in shining armor — 杰克和安妮溜进雾蒙蒙的城堡，遇见一位身穿闪亮盔甲的勇敢骑士！🌳

q.en: Who rides a black horse and rescues Jack and Annie from the castle grounds at the end of the story?
q.zh: 故事结尾，是谁骑着黑马把杰克和安妮从城堡一带救走的？

options.zh: 那位身穿闪亮盔甲的骑士
城堡里一位友善的厨师

options.en: The Duke who judges all the castle thieves
options.zh: 在城堡里审判所有小偷的公爵

explain.en: After Jack and Annie fall into the moat, the knight on the black horse appears in the moonlight, lifts them onto his horse, and rides them to the tree house.
explain.zh: 杰克和安妮掉进护城河后，月光下那位骑黑马的骑士出现，把他们抱上马背，驮着他们回到了树屋。

q.en: According to the castle book, how much could a knight's helmet alone weigh?
q.zh: 根据那本城堡书，骑士的头盔单独一个可能有多重？

options.zh: 超过一百磅，那是别人讲的版本

explain.en: Jack read that a helmet alone could weigh up to forty pounds, which felt to him like riding a horse with a five-year-old on his head.
explain.zh: 杰克读到，光是一个头盔就可能重达四十磅，他觉得就像头顶上骑着一个五岁小孩。

q.en: What does Annie use to make the dungeon guards back away in fear?
q.zh: 在地牢里，安妮用了什么让守卫们害怕地退开？

options.zh: 她的手电筒，她的魔法棒

options.en: A book about knights and castles
options.zh: 一本关于骑士和城堡的书

options.en: A long silver sword from the castle armory
options.zh: 城堡兵器库里的一把长银剑

explain.en: Annie whipped out the flashlight, switched it on, and shouted 'My magic wand!' The guards gasped, dropped their torch, and lay down in fear.
explain.zh: 安妮猛地掏出手电筒打开，大喊'我的魔法棒！'守卫们倒吸一口气，扔掉火把，吓得趴倒在地。

q.en: What crossed the moat and helped protect the castle from enemies?
q.zh: 什么横跨护城河，帮助城堡抵御敌人？

options.en: A ring of very tall, dark trees
options.zh: 一圈非常高、很黑的树木

explain.en: Jack read in the castle book that a drawbridge crossed the moat, and the moat was filled with water to help protect the castle from enemies.
explain.zh: 杰克在城堡书里读到，一座吊桥横跨护城河，而护城河里灌满水，用来帮助城堡抵御敌人。

q.en: What is the name of the town where Jack and Annie live?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮住在哪个小镇？

options.en: A small village in the south of France
options.zh: 法国南部的一座小村庄，不过那是另一个故事了
宾夕法尼亚州的青蛙溪镇

explain.en: Throughout the series Jack and Annie live in Frog Creek, Pennsylvania; Annie points to its picture in the Pennsylvania book to wish them home.
explain.zh: 在整套书里，杰克和安妮都住在宾夕法尼亚州的青蛙溪镇；安妮就是指着宾州书里青蛙溪的照片许愿回家的。

q.en: As Jack and Annie ride the knight's horse toward the tree house, what creature's shriek is heard in the darkness?
q.zh: 当杰克和安妮骑着骑士的马朝树屋走去时，黑暗中传来了哪种动物的尖叫？

explain.en: The text says 'A hawk shrieked in the darkness' just before Annie points out the tree house to the knight.
explain.zh: 书里写道'黑暗中一只鹰发出尖叫'，紧接着安妮就指着树屋给骑士看。

q.en: How does Jack feel as he rocks in the saddle riding with the mysterious knight?
q.zh: 当杰克骑在马鞍上、和神秘的骑士同行时，他感觉怎样？

explain.en: Jack 'felt very brave and very powerful' as the wind blew his hair and he rocked back and forth in the saddle.
explain.zh: 风吹动杰克的头发，他在马鞍上摇来摇去，觉得自己'非常勇敢、非常强大'。

q.en: Where does the secret passage from the storeroom lead?
q.zh: 从储藏室出发的秘密通道通向哪里？

options.en: To a precipice over the moat
options.zh: 通向护城河上方的一处悬崖

options.en: To the cold castle dungeon below
options.zh: 通向城堡下方冰冷的地牢，在很远很远的地方

explain.en: Jack read the map: 'This door leads from the storeroom through a secret passage to a precipice over the moat.' They climbed down and Jack fell into the water.
explain.zh: 杰克看着地图念道：'此门从储藏室经秘密通道通向护城河上方的一处悬崖。'他们爬下去，杰克就掉进了水里。

q.en: What item with the letter M fell out of the castle book and proved a link to the tree house owner?
q.zh: 哪件带有字母 M 的物品从城堡书里掉了出来，证明它与树屋主人有关？

options.en: A long red silk scarf from Japan
options.zh: 一条来自日本的长红丝绸围巾

explain.en: Back home Jack pulled a blue leather bookmark from his pack; it had the same fancy letter M as the gold medallion, showing one person owned the books.
explain.zh: 回到家后，杰克从背包里掏出一条蓝色皮革书签；它和金牌章上一样有一个花体的字母 M，说明这些书是同一个人放的。

q.en: How do Jack and Annie finally get back home from the castle adventure?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮最后是怎么从城堡冒险中回到家的？

options.en: Annie wishes on the book at Frog Creek
options.zh: 安妮在青蛙溪对着书许愿

options.en: They ride the knight's horse all the way home
options.zh: 他们骑着骑士的马一路回家

options.en: They walk back through the woods
options.zh: 他们步行穿过树林回去

explain.en: Annie found the Pennsylvania book, pointed to the picture of Frog Creek, and wished to go home; the tree house spun and they landed back in Frog Creek.
explain.zh: 安妮找出宾州书，指着青蛙溪的照片许愿回家；树屋旋转起来，他们降落在了青蛙溪。
